posts.cooked:
Ok, so. I just REKT The Matriarch at Dok’Thorath, making sure that Tempest killed every target possible (both Cohorts, the Mask, a Carrion Field, 3 or 4 environment targets, every bird that appeared – there were a lot, but never more than like 6 at a time – and The Matriarch herself) with JUST lightning damage. I unlocked him upon victory, and he was not in first position. Legacy was.

So it’s definitely:

Win a game with Vanilla Tempest, at Dok’Thorath. During the game, destroy a bunch of targets

or

do a bunch of damage. (If you have to deal a certain type of damage, it must be lightning damage, since I did nothing but that and got it. It could just be damage in general, and not matter what type you deal.)

posts.name: jorgenp
posts.cooked:
I tried a few things.  First, a lot of projectile damage without muhch destruction, then a lot of lightning damage with some destruction (not much), then a lot of destruction.

The third led to a successful unlock.

Thus, destruction seems to be the key.  Although I don't know why UXM266's unlock didn't work.  Tempest had 13 kills (not including the Villain).

I did put out a lot of Tempest's ongoing cards too, so it might have to do with having certain cards in play as well.  The successful unlock was light on one-shot usage too.

Lightning was not a huge factor in this. 

I'm attaching logs of both my second failed attempt and my third attempt in case they help.

Edit:  I guess we should at least put out one guess for MigrantP:

Regular Tempest wins a battle in Dok'Thorath Capital.  Tempest must destroy at least 10 targets.
